title: Molly and the Tunnel Beneath the Farm Road
synopsis: A roadside ditch and its small culvert need attention after the rain; Molly watches a familiar compact loader restore the gravel edge of the long farm road.
continuity_state: Before: The town street sweeper and vacuum-drain truck have completed their separate jobs near Brook Road. At Green Gate Farm, the red tractor, hay barn, feed container, and green wheelbarrow are all in their established places. Little Bridge remains pedestrian-only. After: The existing culvert under a shallow low point of the long farm road is first described. Adults remove fallen leaves from its inlet and check that water can travel through the pipe. A small compact loader brings gravel to restore the soft road shoulder; the road is checked and usable again. Molly and Rex see each other at the farm, and their familiar tail greeting continues.
